description: Process multiple independent GCD pairs simultaneously using AVX2/AVX-512. Main challenge: TZCNT has no SIMD equivalent - must emulate via bit isolation and LZCNT.
mathematical_formalization: For 4 pairs in AVX2: 4x SUB, 4x blend (replaces CMOV), 4x NEG+blend (abs), 4x emulated TZCNT, 4x variable shift.
implementation_hypothesis: Emulate TZCNT: t = v & (-v) isolates lowest bit; use VPLZCNTD or VPSHUFB nibble lookup for bit position.
experiment_seed: Implement batch of 4 GCDs in AVX2. Measure throughput vs 4 sequential scalar GCDs.
